title: L-Sit (Floor or Parallettes)
summary: A support hold on the floor or parallettes with your legs held out straight, for the abs and hip flexors.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: parallettes or dip bars or power tower.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.6 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.3 for quads (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.15 for triceps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Put your hands beside your hips and press down.
Lift your hips and legs until your legs are straight out in front.

form_cues.cue: Lift the legs to hip height
Tuck your knees in if you can't straighten your legs yet.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Easier to learn.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
